expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.piiri==='led' && S.U===5 && S.R===330 && S.komponentti==='punainen' && S.suunta==='paasto' && S.G===1000 && S.Rk===50 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: LED circuit, U = 5,0 V, R = 330 ohm, red LED forward; panel G = 1000 W/m2, R = 50 ohm (must run before any setup)
on load: U_D of the red LED = 1,90 V (lesson-answers sim-UD)
on load: I = (U - U_D) : R = 9,40 mA (sim-I)
on load: U_R = R I = 3,10 V (sim-UR)
on load: P_D = U_D I = 17,8 mW
on load: 9,4 mA, no overload

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const ok=(r,a,b,s)=>r.min===a&&r.max===b&&r.step===s; return R.length===4 && ok(R[0],'0','9','0.1') && ok(R[1],'100','1000','10') && ok(R[2],'0','1000','50') && ok(R[3],'0','300','1') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four sliders: U 0-9,0 V by 0,1; R 100-1000 ohm by 10; G 0-1000 W/m2 by 50; load 0-300 ohm by 1

expr: (() => { const S=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')]; const o=(s)=>[...s.options].map(x=>x.value).join(); return S.length===3 && o(S[0])==='led,kenno' && o(S[1])==='piidiodi,punainen,sininen' && o(S[2])==='paasto,esto' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three selects: circuit (LED, solar), component (Si, red, blue), direction (forward, reverse)
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='G,R,Rk,U,komponentti,piiri,suunta' && P.U.unit==='V' && P.R.unit==='Ω' && P.Rk.unit==='Ω' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares piiri, U (V), R (ohm), komponentti, suunta, G, Rk (ohm)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?1100:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x1100 (circuit and graph stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
